messages.subject: Critical Minerals Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Anouska,

Your executive-search work across critical minerals, batteries, clean fuels and energy-transition leadership is highly relevant to my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where critical-minerals growth requires trusted government, regulatory and community relationships. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
